CORRIGENDUM TO THE E-TENDER NOTICE F.No.31/27/2022-E&F(SIA)
DATED 03.02.2022

#/texts/5.label: paragraph
#/texts/5.full_gt_text: Whereas the Department had published E-tender vide F.No.31/27/2022-E&F(SIA) dated 03.02.2022 for the empanelment of agencies to conduct Social Impact Assessment studies at Lakshadweep as per the various provisions in the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act-2013 (30 of 2013) and Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement (Social Impact Assessment & Consent) Rules 2014.

#/texts/6.label: paragraph
#/texts/6.full_gt_text: And whereas the last date for accepting this tender was 15.02.2022. Now in order to have wider participation for this tender, the time schedule described at para 8.1 had been rescheduled as below.

#/texts/7.label: paragraph
#/texts/7.full_gt_text: 8.1 Time schedule for obtaining bid documents, submission of bids and opening of bids as follows.

#/texts/10.label: paragraph
#/texts/10.full_gt_text: This is issued with the approval of Competent Authority

#/texts/12.label: paragraph
#/texts/12.full_gt_text:
1) The Notice Board
2) The SIO, NIC for publishing in the e-tender website and modifying in www.tendersutl.gov.in.
3) The Web Coordinator, Environment & Forest, Kavaratti to publish in the Official Website of the UTLA.
4) The Director, Dept. of Information & Public Relation with request to make wide publicity in all islands
5) The Editor, Lakshadweep Times with a request to publish in the next edition of Lakshadweep times.
6) The DC/SDO in all the Islands with request to publish in the notice board.
